name: Calf Raises
description: Strengthens the calf muscles: holding a wall for balance, rise slowly onto the balls of both feet and lower back down.

source.title: NHS podiatry: calf strengthening guide
source.note: Stick-figure approximation; the heel is drawn at the ankle.

setup: Stand on a level surface, feet about 15 cm (6 in) apart.
Rest your hands on a wall or other stable surface for balance.
cues: Take about 3 seconds to rise and 3 seconds to lower.
Keep your knees straight but not locked.
Push evenly through the whole width of each foot.

prescription.note: Start with 5 repetitions 3 times a day and build up to 20 repetitions 5 times a day. Move on to single-leg raises when this feels easy.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Feet flat, hands on the wall.

keyframes.name: Rise onto your toes
keyframes.cue: Slowly lift both heels until you're on the balls of your feet.
